gaps: No land use is inventoried although section 3.5 says the system includes land use; only the 'chemical plant, organics' infrastructure proxy carries it.
No waste-water treatment input and no cooling water released back to water.
No sodium sulfate co-product: the excerpt describes the 96 % grade route producing sodium sulfate, but the inventory models the boric-acid fusing route with a single product.
Energy and cooling water are both proxies from an unrelated German chemical site (Gendorf 2000), so their absolute level is weak.
